newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas barely traded, OTC also quiet, flex bus.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas barely traded, OTC also quiet, flex bus.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market saw a typically quiet start to the week on Tuesday, with only a single trade done for five lots, the minimum tradeable volume.
The deal was done in the contract's outermost month, May 1998, at 11.00 pence a therm, a fall of 0.10 pence from the previous settlement level posted on Friday evening.

A physical market trader said the OTC market had also been quiet today, although there was discussion on the day ahead market in a wide range of 11.00/12.50 pence a therm, and the balance of May was talked around 10.60 pence a therm.
There was trade on the flexibility mechanism on Tuesday morning, with the system buying a maximum of 108,082,341 kWh, or around 3.17 million therms.
This followed a purchase of a maximum 9.5 million therms on Monday, when a sudden change to cold weather caused the system to buy heavily.
